passages.title: Ukážka 4 – Remote work
passages.body: More and more companies allow their employees to work from home. Supporters argue that it saves time and money, because people do not have to commute. However, critics warn that workers may feel isolated and find it hard to separate work from private life. A recent study suggests that the most successful model is a mix of both: two or three days at home and the rest in the office.

passages.title: Ukážka 8 – The value of sleep
passages.body: Although many people believe that they can function perfectly well on five hours of sleep, research suggests otherwise. Chronic sleep deprivation has been linked to poor concentration, weakened immunity and even a higher risk of heart disease. Researchers stress that it is not only the quantity of sleep that matters, but also its quality: regular bedtimes and a dark, quiet room can make a considerable difference.

questions.prompt: By 2020 she ___ in London for five years.
questions.explanation: By 2020 odkazuje na minulosť: predminulý čas (past perfect).

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: Po does not nasleduje základný tvar slovesa bez -s.

questions.prompt: If she ___ harder, she would pass the exam.
questions.explanation: Nereálna podmienka: if + minulý čas, would.

questions.prompt: By the time she is 30, she ___ three languages.
questions.explanation: By the time + budúci bod: future perfect (will have + 3. tvar), dej bude dokončený skôr.

questions.prompt: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot his books.
questions.explanation: Po „Not only“ na začiatku vety nasleduje obrátený slovosled: Not only was he late…

questions.prompt: Čo znamená „reluctant“?
questions.explanation: Reluctant = neochotný, zdráhavý. Opak: willing = ochotný.

questions.prompt: The company decided to ___ the project due to high costs.
questions.explanation: Abandon = opustiť, zrušiť. Adopt = prijať, remain = zostať.

questions.prompt: She ___ have left already; her coat is gone.
questions.explanation: Must have + 3. tvar = takmer istý odhad o minulosti.

questions.prompt: Had I known about the traffic, I ___ earlier.
questions.explanation: Inverzia z podmienky: Had I known = If I had known. Výsledok: would have + 3. tvar.

questions.prompt: He is responsible ___ the whole project.
questions.explanation: Responsible for = zodpovedný za niečo.

questions.prompt: She is not used ___ the cold weather.
questions.explanation: Be used to + podstatné meno / -ing = byť zvyknutý na niečo.

questions.prompt: No sooner had I arrived ___ the phone rang.
questions.explanation: Po no sooner vždy nasleduje than (nie when).

questions.prompt: What do supporters of remote work say?
options: It is cheaper for companies only.
questions.explanation: Podľa textu ušetrí čas aj peniaze, pretože ľudia nemusia dochádzať.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to “commute”?
questions.explanation: Commute = dochádzať do práce.

questions.prompt: What does the study suggest?
options: A mix of home and office work works best.
questions.explanation: Štúdia odporúča kombináciu práce z domu aj z kancelárie.

questions.prompt: It is high time we ___ home.
questions.explanation: Po „It is high time“ nasleduje minulý čas (nereálna prítomnosť): it is high time we went.

questions.prompt: I would rather you ___ me the truth yesterday.
questions.explanation: Would rather + minulosť: past perfect (had told).

questions.prompt: Čo znamená „ubiquitous“?
questions.explanation: Ubiquitous = všadeprítomný, vyskytujúci sa všade.

questions.prompt: Choose the word closest in meaning to “scarce”.
questions.explanation: Scarce = nedostatkový, vzácny. Opak: plentiful = hojný.

questions.prompt: She takes great pride ___ her work.
questions.explanation: Take pride in = byť hrdý na niečo.

questions.prompt: You ___ have told me earlier! Now it is too late.
questions.explanation: Could have + 3. tvar = výčitka (mohol si mi to povedať).

questions.prompt: Were it not for your help, I ___ failed.
questions.explanation: Inverzia: Were it not for = If it were not for. Výsledok: would have + 3. tvar.

questions.prompt: What does research suggest about five hours of sleep?
options: It is enough for most people.
It is not enough for most people.
questions.explanation: V texte výskum naznačuje, že päť hodín spánku nestačí.

questions.prompt: Which result of sleep deprivation is mentioned?
options: A higher risk of heart disease
questions.explanation: V texte: „a higher risk of heart disease“.

questions.prompt: What can improve the quality of sleep?
options: Regular bedtimes and a dark, quiet room
questions.explanation: V texte: „regular bedtimes and a dark, quiet room“.
